objective: Sequential focused-task campaign to improve validated learning efficiency and higher-order quantitative-research capability.
process_conclusion: Focused-task/frontier-first selection is associated with a qualitatively better information flow than the prior opportunistic queue. The opportunistic period concentrated roughly five-to-six activations refining a single MA-crossover hypothesis through queued follow-on items (MA on real data, regime-stable, regime-adaptive, turbulent-only filter, regime-dependent deep-dive, per-asset t-statistics), repeatedly rescuing the same idea. The frontier-first period instead closed five distinct new-signal-class cells decisively (four FALSIFIED, one SUPPORTED) with independent verification and no equivalent re-tests, and produced the campaign's first positive candidate (momentum). The advantage is concrete but observational and confounded by toolkit maturation, so it supports RETAIN rather than a stronger causal claim.
research_conclusion: NEGATIVE / INVALIDATING. The assigned cost grid was executed as predeclared and independently verified. For the signal as recorded (bt.momentum_signals), costs are immaterial: zero-cost 17/30 EDGE cells, realistic 18/30, stress_2x 18/30, median of cell medians unchanged at +0.0686 per 84-day fold, per-asset cost drag <= 0.001 per fold, classification 6 COST_ROBUST / 4 NO_EDGE_ZERO_COST. That result is not evidence about momentum: the audited signal is a step function of the adjusted price level (constant +1.0 in 27/30 cells; NVDA flips sign once when its split-adjusted price crosses 1.0), so the tested position is constant-long large-cap equity and the measured medians are the equity risk premium, and the lookback parameter only shifts the entry by a few bars. A docstring-faithful log-return momentum, evaluated on the identical grid with the identical rule, yields 0/30 EDGE cells at every cost level (zero-cost median of cell medians +0.0069, realistic +0.0010, stress_2x +0.0008; all 10 assets NO_EDGE_ZERO_COST) and turns over about 105x capital per year at the realistic level. No claim of profitability is made for any asset; the durable contribution is that the campaign's only positive candidate is invalidated at the implementation level, that the falsified reversal cell is likewise a constant-short position, and that the cost question is closed for this construction.

The momentum hypothesis is not tested at any other construction: only one corrected implementation (sign of the past N-day log return, hold 1 day) was run, so a different horizon, holding period, or signal form could still show an edge.
